The technical validation of any solution must be performed by qualified professionals.

content: The user commits to: providing true and complete information; using the Platform lawfully; not attempting to access unauthorized systems or data; and not using the Platform for abusive, fraudulent, or illegal purposes.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller Identification
content: Watt Builder is a digital project currently in the development phase.
For any questions regarding personal data: Email: general@watt-builder.com | Website: www.watt-builder.com

sections.title: 2. Personal Data Collected
content: Watt Builder may collect the following data:
• Contact data: Email address (when provided by the user).

• Energy and technical data: Energy consumption, solar production, housing characteristics (e.g., area, number of people, approximate location), and energy equipment (e.g., solar panels, inverters, batteries).
• Usage data: Interactions with the platform and navigation data (e.g., IP address, device, browser).

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Processing
content: The data is used to: generate personalized energy recommendations; simulate scenarios and savings estimates; improve the platform's models and operation; and ensure the security and performance of the service.
Data will not be used for commercial purposes without explicit consent.

sections.title: 4. Legal Basis
content: Data processing is based on: execution of features requested by the user; user consent; and legitimate interest in improving the platform.

sections.title: 5. Data Sharing
content: Watt Builder does not sell personal data.
Data will not be shared with third parties, except when required by law or when the user gives explicit consent.

sections.title: 6. Data Retention
content: Data will be kept only for the time necessary for the platform to function, or until the user requests its deletion.

sections.title: 7. User Rights
content: Under the GDPR, the user has the right to: access their data, correct incorrect data, request data deletion, object to processing, and request restriction of processing.
To exercise your rights, contact us at general@watt-builder.com.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
content: The platform may use cookies to ensure the website functions and to improve user experience.
For more details, please see the Cookie Policy.

sections.title: 9. Automated Decisions
content: Watt Builder uses automated models to generate recommendations.
These recommendations are based on the data provided, do not produce binding legal effects, and do not replace technical validation by professionals.

sections.title: 10. Changes to the Policy
content: Watt Builder may update this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be published on the website.

sections.title: 11. Contact
content: For any questions related to data protection: general@watt-builder.com.
The user may also file a complaint with the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD).

sections.title: 12. Acceptance
content: Use of the platform implies acceptance of this Privacy Policy.

businessProduct.title: Smarter Battery Design, Lower Development Costs
businessProduct.paragraph1: Our company combines advanced software and expert consulting to deliver optimized battery design solutions. Leveraging real cell testing data and state-of-the-art degradation models, our platform simulates electric vehicles and energy systems while calculating ROI based on each client's business case.
businessProduct.paragraph2: It transforms requirements into production-ready designs, in minutes, by generating and comparing all possible configurations from our extensive cell database against market alternatives. Through our consulting services, we provide tailored guidance at every stage of development, while clients who wish to reduce costs can also operate the software independently and access our validated database or integrate their own.
